en: The Office of Minister of State

kurals.tr: Karuviyum Kaalamum Seykaiyum Seyyum / Aruvinaiyum Maantadhu Amaichchu
kurals.m: The minister is one who can make an excellent choice of means, time, manner of execution, and the difficult undertaking (itself)

kurals.tr: Vankan Kutikaaththal Katraridhal Aalvinaiyotu / Aindhutan Maantadhu Amaichchu
kurals.m: The minister is one who in addition to the aforesaid five things excels in the possession of firmness,

kurals.tr: Piriththalum Penik Kolalum Pirindhaarp / Poruththalum Valla Thamaichchu
kurals.m: The minister is one who can effect discord (among foes), maintain the good-will of his friends and restore to friendship those who have seceded (from him)

kurals.tr: Theridhalum Therndhu Seyalum Orudhalaiyaach / Chollalum Valladhu Amaichchu
kurals.m: The minister is one who is able to comprehend (the whole nature of an undertaking), execute it in the best manner possible, and offer assuring advice (in time of necessity)

kurals.tr: Aranarindhu Aandramaindha Sollaanenj Gnaandrun / Thiranarindhaan Therchchith Thunai
kurals.m: He is the best helper (of the king) who understanding the duties, of the latter, is by his special learning, able to tender the fullest advice, and at all times conversant with the best method (of

kurals.tr: Madhinutpam Noolotu Utaiyaarkku Adhinutpam / Yaavula Munnir Pavai
kurals.m: What (contrivances) are there so acute as to resist those who possess natural acuteness in addition to learning ?

kurals.tr: Seyarkai Arindhak Kataiththum Ulakaththu / Iyarkai Arindhu Seyal
kurals.m: Though you are acquainted with the (theoretical) methods (of performing an act), understand the ways of the world and act accordingly

kurals.tr: Arikondru Ariyaan Eninum Urudhi / Uzhaiyirundhaan Kooral Katan
kurals.m: Although the king be utterly ignorant, it is the duty of the minister to give (him) sound advice

kurals.tr: Pazhudhennum Mandhiriyin Pakkadhadhul Thevvor / Ezhupadhu Koti Urum
kurals.m: Far better are seventy crores of enemies (for a king) than a minister at his side who intends (his) ruin

kurals.tr: Muraippatach Choozhndhum Mutivilave Seyvar / Thirappaatu Ilaaa Thavar
kurals.m: Those ministers who are destitute of (executive) ability will fail to carry out their projects, although they may have contrived aright
